$comment: M02e look shots: fixed cameras for the goldens (tests/e2e/golden/look) and the before/after image (docs/look). ENU metres from City Hall (+X east, -Z north); y is the eye height above the ground under the camera; yaw 0 looks north (-Z), 90 west. Positions of the first four are in the Civic Center and the commercial blocks of the synth world, which every CI run bakes; the two `sf-civic-*` shots stand on Civic Center Plaza of the real `sf` bake (the before/after of `docs/look`, optional) and are not part of the goldens. The hour and weather are locked with a zero-second blend.
